candidate.version_description: This is the Ricky Skaggs/Bruce Hornsby version of The Hills of Mexico with an extra verse from the traditional arrangement. Key of C so I can actually sing it without hurting myself. or shouting. View at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ncWVa3da6jM.

content:
[Intro]

[ch]C[/ch] [ch]Am[/ch] [ch]F[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]   [ch]Am[/ch]                       [ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]C[/ch]
When I's in old Fort Worth in eighteen and eighty-three[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
This old Mexican Cowboy come stepin' up to me[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                  [ch]F[/ch]                            [ch]C[/ch]
Sayin' how are you, young fella, how would you like to go[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]   [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]F[/ch]                          [ch]C[/ch]
And spend another season 'neath them hills of Mexico?[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]     [ch]Am[/ch]                      [ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]
Well, I had no employment and back to him did say[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]
It's accordin' to your wages, it's accordin' to your pay[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]              [ch]F[/ch]                         [ch]C[/ch]
Said I'd pay to you good wages and often, too, you know[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]         [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]F[/ch]                          [ch]C[/ch]
If you'll spend another season 'neath the hills of Mexico[/tab]

[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]                             [ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]C[/ch]
Now with all this Flatterin' talkin' he signed up quite a train[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]               [ch]F[/ch]                       [ch]C[/ch]
Some ten or twelve in number, all able bodied men[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]                                  [ch]C[/ch]
And our trip it was pleasant as we hit the western road[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]                    [ch]F[/ch]                         [ch]C[/ch]
Till we crossed the old Peace River to those hills of Mexico[/tab]

[Verse 4]

[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                  [ch]F[/ch]                            [ch]C[/ch]
It was there our pleasures ended and our troubles all begun[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]     [ch]Am[/ch]                    [ch]F[/ch]                          [ch]C[/ch]
Was a lightening storm that hit us and made the cattle run[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]              [ch]F[/ch]                                 [ch]C[/ch]
And we all got full of stickers from the cactus that did grow[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]                [ch]F[/ch]                               [ch]C[/ch]
And the outlaws there did rob us 'neath those hills of Mexico[/tab]

[Verse 5]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                        [ch]C[/ch]
Now the round-up's over and that cowboy would not pay,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                                   [ch]C[/ch]
He said we'd been so extravagant that we's in his debt that day.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                                   [ch]C[/ch]
But we showed him about the punchers, that bankrupt would not go,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                                   [ch]C[/ch]
So we left that feller's bones to bleach in the hills of Mexico[/tab]

[Verse 6]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]         [ch]Am[/ch]                 [ch]F[/ch]                              [ch]C[/ch]
Well, they sent along that old steamboat and back to home did go[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]         [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]F[/ch]                                 [ch]C[/ch]
How those bells started ringing, them whistles they did blow[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]     [ch]Am[/ch]                  [ch]F[/ch]                                    [ch]C[/ch]
Going back to friends and loves ones and I'll tell them not to go[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]F[/ch]                              [ch]C[/ch]
To that God-forsaken country 'neath them hills of Mexico[/tab]
